notes.title: 1.7.6 Update & Introducing our new project
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31383556/f209953b912bb84c7ba99d6211e0b7af06786b42.png[/img]

Hello, this is Team Horay.
We've fixed some bugs with this minor patch.



[h1]Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Item Naitel Hovering Shield: Fixed a bug with the skill.
[*]Item Thunderbird's Eye: Fixed an issue with "Exploding Bullets" stat not working correctly.
[*]Boss [spoiler]Tunak[/spoiler]: Fixed an issue where monsters sometimes remained after the battle ended.
[*]Boss [spoiler]Roellynn[/spoiler]: Fixed a bug where some objects remained on the screen after being defeated.
[*]The fairy that shows you the way to the restaurant is no longer obscured by tiles.
[*]Chinese, Japanese: Fixed a broken Steam workshop text label on the title screen.
[/list]





[h1]Introducing Sephiria, our new project[/h1]

We released Dungreed in February 2018 and have been updating it continuously for about 5.5 years.
This wouldn't have been possible without your support. thank you.

Currently, we are hard at work on a new game [b]Sephiria[/b].
It's a fast-paced action game in the top-down view roguelite genre. 

We have a temporary Steam page up for now, but we plan to keep releasing more information about the game.
If you're interested, check out our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2436940/Sephiria/]Steam page[/url] and add this to your wishlist! :)

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2436940/Sephiria/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31383556/b42e67ac93fef687324427f8169e7b5255286844.png[/img][/url]









We wish everyone a very happy holiday season.
Thank you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31383556/b2b79940499a295e443272c926b54cce11771545.gif[/img]

notes.title: 1.5.7 Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Monster[/h1]
- Fixed a bug where the door of the room would open without killing the spider.

[h1]Upgrade[/h1]
- Fixed a bug that items can be upgraded regardless of conditions when moving items by dragging in the anvil upgrade menu.
- Fixed a bug that could allow player to take items powered by the Anvil Blacksmith into town.
- Changed the Forestall effect.[quote] The bonus damage effect ignores the enemy's defense and inflicts fixed damage regardless of the current attack speed. The additional damage value has been changed from 10% to 6%. [/quote]
[h1]Items[/h1]
- Increased the attack speed of all charged weapons. 
- Rumble and Arthur: Fixed an issue that caused the weapon to disappear when using the skill after the full swing option was granted.
- Ormungand, Will Cane, Laplacian, Gáe Bulg: The effect now works even with the infinite magazine option.
- Thunder Kunai: Damage changed from 8~12 to 6~10. Fixed an issue where attack speed was not displayed properly.
- Rapier of Super Speed: Damage changed from 5~10 to 4~9. Fixed an issue where attack speed was not displayed properly.

[h1]Item Set[/h1]
- Heliotrope: Secondary weapon attacks no longer recover health.

notes.title: 1.5.6 Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Dungeon & Battle[/h1]
- The Anvil/Blacksmith enhancement system has been slightly changed.[quote]1. Anvil and Blacksmith upgrades are now considered separate upgrades. In other words, even items that have been upgraded once as a blacksmith can be upgraded separately from the anvil.
    2. Upgrade of the same type is limited to once. Items once used by the Blacksmith cannot be entrusted to the Blacksmith again. (The anvil is the same.)
    3. Blacksmith's item performance enhancement value is +10%.
[/quote]- Blocking or evading Ice/Fire Bats' attack no longer take DOT effects.
- The mark of Lotus is not left behind after the boss is defeated.
- All existing bullets in the room will be deleted at the start of the boss battle.
- Fixed several rooms where rewards could not be obtained.

[h1]Item[/h1]
- Fixed an issue that Witch Sword Livna's fragment attack is triggered by attacks from other weapons.
- Fixed an issue where all attack speeds were reduced when equipped with a Magical Magnifying Glass, even if only one of the main weapons and secondary weapons were ranged weapons.
- Fixed an issue where the Camping Hatchet's ranged attacks were not considered as direct attacks.
- Fixed an issue where the skill of Lu Bu's Spear could not block physical ranged attacks.
- Mondria has been changed to allow reloading even when the bullet is full when using the infinite magazine option.
- Fixed some camera animation errors.

[h1]Town[/h1]
- Fixed an issue where tiles in the village graveyard were not visible properly.

[h1]Co-op[/h1]
- Fixed a bug where the players are forced to return to the village when the dog falls down during the player 1's Minotaur Stake resurrection.
- Fixed a bug where the dog would become intermittently invincible after Kaminela.

notes.title: Dungreed Version 1.5 Patch Note
notes.notes:
:: New Languages Support ::
- Spanish(Español), Russian(Pусский) and German(Deutsch) are added.

:: Local Co-op::
- When more than 1 controller is connected to your PC, you can enter the dungeon with your dog.

:: Dungeon ::
- Dungeon loading time is slightly decreased.
- 2 new dungeon objects are added.
- The rooms that already existed are slightly changed.
- The moving saw blade's paths will be shown.

:: Hard Mode ::
- The defense of monsters and bosses in hard mode is adjusted.
- The trials are unavailable in hard mode.

:: Monsters ::
- 4 new monsters are added.
- The attack cycle of the hell grass is changed
- The range of the lizardman shieldbearer's attack is changed.
- The below monsters' attack preparation motion is added.
- Wood bomb, steel bomb, gatling sentry gun, skellydog, astrape, steel skellydog, banshee, hellhound, orthus and cerberus.
- The speed of flame bat's projectile has constant velocity now.

:: Bosses ::
- The boss reward is changed.
- The patterns of Devana are changed.
- The patterns of Lasley are partially changed.
- Tunak and Kaminela's health is increased slightly.
- Dash invincibility is no longer applied to the walls summoned by Envirok.

:: Items ::
- 18 new items are added.
- Item options such as Starting Pressure, Full Swing, and Infinite Ammo are added.
- Nitro Gauntlet's attack is changed.
- Rumble and Arthur's skill style is changed.
- Dash Shield's performance and attack range is improved.
- Gwendolyn's skill damage and cool-time is decreased.
- Fixed an issue where automatic pistol could not be got.
- Fixed a problem that Thunderbird's Eye's attack did not work for certain monsters.
- Indecision is deleted.
- The performance of some items has been adjusted.

:: Set ::
- 12 new set effects are added.
- Cosmic Power set skill cool-down is changed.
- The previously activated set is displayed in the item description window.

:: NPC ::
- 1 new NPC is added.

:: UI ::
- The UI screen for selecting food is slightly improved.
- Added hard mode options in Quick Start.
- The secondary weapon is displayed in the HUD.
- The reload of the auxiliary weapon is displayed in the HUD.
- The number of bullets is displayed in the item description window.
- Press-and-hold buttons are added.
- The layout of Setting Menu is changed.

:: Sound ::
- Fixed some sound effects.
- Fixed the problem that the ambience sound of the dungeon is not normally output.

:: Control ::
- Automatic aiming mode is added to improve joystick usability.

:: Game Play ::
- The player's hitbox has become smaller.
- Tutorial is improved.
- 20% defensive penetration added to the 20 level effect of Ability Wrath.
- You can now avoid traps and status effects by dash invincibility.
- When multiple effects with dash invincibility are acquired at the same time, the invincibility time will be increased.
- 7 new foods will be added.
- The active effect of food "Beer" is increased.
- The negative effects of red pill are reduced by 50%.

notes.title: 200116 : Hotfix
notes.notes:
[h2]Change Log[/h2]
[list]
[*] Max frame rate limit option is added.
[*] Fixed an issue that Steam Cloud is not working properly on macOS.
[*] Converted app to 64bit for macOS 10.15 Catalina support.
[/list]



[h2]!!! Please note !!![/h2]
After applying this patch, save files of users who have been playing games on both Windows and macOS at the same time might be overwrited to Steam Cloud.
We recommend backing up your save file before you run the game.

To back up your save files, you need to access to the path below.

Steam Library > Right click on Dungreed > Properties... > LOCAL FILES tab > BROWSE LOCAL FILES...
Windows: Dungreed_Data\\StreamingAssets\\Slot*.uml
macOS: Contents/Resources/Data/StreamingAssets/Slot*.uml
* contains the slot number.

Even if you didn't back up your save file before the update, the previous progress is stored in the BackUps folder in the StreamingAssets folder.
Change the file name and extension to match the format of "Slot*.uml".



[h3]little notice[/h3]
In addition, when you report an error or bug, please include the log file for quick feedback.
The log file is located at:
Windows: ~\\Dungreed\\Dungreed_Data\\output_log.txt
macOS: ~/Library/Logs/Unity/Editor.log

And our team is currently working on

[list]
[*] Porting Dungreed to Nintendo Switch / PS4.
[*] Preparing new patches including new additional language supports.
[/list]


We appreciate your playing our game even though it has been a long time since the game was released.
So we hope to get back to you with good news soon!

- Fixed a bug that sometimes did not resurrect when defeat Lasley.
- Fixed a bug that evil fanatic shaman did not disappear when he died.
- Fixed a bug that problem of screen offset when meet the slime maker.

- Fixed some maps.

- Adjusted the cost of building construction.
- Adjusted the ability of Berdish, Hand crossbow and golden candy.

- Reduced the attack range of Hellgrass / Hellflower.


Thank you.
